Task guide

Bank account synchronisation

Bank movements arrive in Odoo by themselves — Fio banka through your own token, Tatra banka through its Premium API — with no files to download or import, with payment symbols and the counterparty's account.

CountrySlovakia
EditionOdoo Community
Coversaccount_fio, account_statement_fio, account_tatrabanka (delivered separately), account_statement_tatrabanka (delivered separately), account_tatrabanka_webhook (delivered separately), l10n_cssk_payment_symbols, l10n_cssk_payment_symbols_oca

What this guide is for

With synchronisation a bank journal fills itself: every hour Odoo asks the bank for new movements and creates statement lines with the counterparty's account, the variable, constant and specific symbols and the message to the payee. Nothing is downloaded from internet banking or imported. The lines are then matched exactly as lines of an imported statement — automatically by variable symbol, and by hand in Reconcile — as the Bank guide describes.

Bank How it connects Who switches it on
Fio banka a token from Fio internet banking, entered on the bank journal you — the Fio banka — bank statements module from Apps
Tatra banka, and other banks reached through Tatra banka's Premium API an authorisation you give at the bank; the credentials for the bank are held by Data Dance our team — ask us to enable it

Other banks do not send their statements by themselves yet: download a CAMT.053 statement and import it as in the Bank guide. A journal is fed by one route only — its Bank Feeds field holds a single value — so the same movement never arrives twice.

Fio banka

The token in internet banking

In Fio internet banking open Nastavení → API and create a read-only token for the account to synchronise. A token belongs to one account, is valid for at most 180 days and becomes usable five minutes after it is authorised. Note its expiry date as well. Payment orders from Odoo would need a separate write token; statements only need the read token, which cannot pay anyone.

Setting up the journal

  1. Once, install the Fio banka — bank statements module from Apps.
  2. Open the bank journal of the Fio account (Accounting → Configuration → Accounting → Journals; a new one is created as in the Bank guide). Its Bank Account Number must be the account the token belongs to.
  3. In the Fio banka section fill in Fio Read Token and Fio Read Token Expires and click Test connection. Odoo makes one call to Fio, shows what the bank reports about the account (account number, IBAN, currency) and writes it to the journal's history. A token of another account, or of an account in another currency than the journal's, is refused.
  4. Set Bank Feeds to Fio banka API, choose the Fio Pull Mode (below) and click Pull now.

From then on the journal is pulled every hour. Only administrators see and enter the tokens. All journals with a token and their expiry dates are listed in Accounting → Configuration → Accounting → Fio banka; a date already passed is red. Before a token expires, create a new one in internet banking and replace it on the journal.

Pull mode

Fio Pull Mode What each pull does When to choose it
Movements (default) reads the movements of the last Fio re-read days (3 by default) and adds those Odoo does not have everyday matching
Official numbered statements downloads every statement issued by the bank that Odoo lacks, with the bank's opening and closing balance when you want statements in Odoo identical to the bank's
Since the bookmark on the token downloads everything since the bookmark Fio keeps only with a token nothing else uses

Movements of an earlier period are downloaded with Pull a range… on the journal. Fio provides movements older than 90 days only while the token's history is unlocked in internet banking (Nastavení → API, the padlock), and the unlock lasts ten minutes.

If you have been importing GPC files, switch at a day boundary: import the last statement and start pulling the next day — movements from GPC and from the API do not recognise each other.

Tatra banka

Tatra banka's Premium API connects accounts at Tatra banka and, through the same authorisation, accounts at some other Slovak banks. The credentials for the bank are not in your Odoo — the Data Dance service holds them. Our team switches the connection on; you then give consent at the bank once:

  1. Accounting → Configuration → Tatra banka Premium API → Authorisations → New, choose the application our team prepared, save and click Authorise at the bank.
  2. On Tatra banka's authorisation portal, a person with at least passive internet banking rights to the accounts logs in and selects the accounts to release. Finish within 30 minutes.
  3. Back in Odoo, a bank journal whose account number is exactly a released IBAN is connected by itself. Other released accounts are assigned with Connect accounts — each to an Existing journal, a New journal, or Do not connect.
  4. On the connected journal set Bank Feeds to Tatra banka Premium API. On its Tatra banka tab choose Import: Transactions, or Transactions + monthly statements (one statement per month, for example TBSK 2026-10), and click Pull transactions.

From then on transactions are pulled every hour; Pull a range… fills in older ones (15 months back for accounts at Tatra banka, 13 for accounts at other banks). Only booked movements are imported.

The consent lasts 180 days and belongs to the person who gave it. Two weeks before it ends the authorisation gets an activity saying access to Tatra banka expires; renew it with Re-authorise on the authorisation, and the journals stay connected. If the person who gave consent is leaving, have someone else authorise before they go.

Checking

  • The journal shows Fio Last Pull At, or Last pulled / Latest movement for Tatra banka.
  • A failed pull is written to the journal's history with the bank's reason; the other journals are pulled regardless.
  • At month end compare the closing balance in Odoo with the balance on the bank's statement, as in the Bank guide — the balances of monthly statements are computed from their lines, not taken from the bank.

Posting and matching the lines does not change: the Bank guide describes them.
